values.binNote: The bin has no calculation row that multiplies TotalDamageTooltip by ReducedDamagePercent (30%, i.e. the wiki's 70% multiplier is 1-0.30); the wiki's reduced-damage numbers (60*0.7=42 etc., 55%*0.7=38.5% AP) are derived from BaseDamage and ReducedDamagePercent but no bin calculation states this product directly.

mechanics.claim: The Ball deals damage to enemies it passes through in flight and again to nearby enemies upon arrival, with damage beyond the first target hit reduced to 70%.
